answer: Answers are salted with a 230 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the relic salt is published after the saffron checkpoint, the voyage audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 115 keys as a result pays for 115 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
